name: Unuspay Crypto Payments for WooCommerce
author: unustech01

sections.description:
Unuspay Crypto Payments for WooCommerce helps your store accept crypto payments without making checkout or order management harder to run.

Some customers want to pay with crypto. As a WooCommerce merchant, you probably want to serve those customers, but you do not want a confusing checkout, manual payment matching, or another payment workflow your team has to babysit.

Unuspay adds a crypto payment option to WooCommerce. Customers choose Unuspay at checkout, pay with a supported wallet, and your store receives payment-status updates by webhook after payment.

The result is simple: your customers get a familiar crypto payment flow, and your team can keep managing orders inside WooCommerce.

Accept Crypto Payments from More Customers

Unuspay helps WooCommerce stores accept payments across popular crypto networks, including Ethereum, Base, Polygon, BNB Smart Chain, Tron, and EVM-compatible chains.

That means customers can pay with native coins and stablecoins from the wallets they already use, while your store keeps the order workflow inside WooCommerce.

Supported Blockchains

Unuspay currently supports:

  • Ethereum and EVM-compatible chains
  • Base
  • Polygon
  • BNB Smart Chain

These networks are widely used for crypto commerce, especially stablecoin payments, lower-cost transactions, and wallet-based checkout.

Supported Tokens by Chain

Unuspay supports native coins and stablecoins on supported networks. Current enabled tokens include:

Ethereum
– ETH – Ether
– USDC – USD Coin
– USDT – Tether USD
– DAI – Dai Stablecoin
– WETH – Wrapped Ether

Polygon
– POL – Polygon native token
– USDC – USD Coin
– USDT – Tether USD
– DAI – Dai Stablecoin

BNB Smart Chain
– BNB – BNB
– USDT – Tether USD
– USDC – USD Coin
– FDUSD – First Digital USD
– TUSD – TrueUSD
– DAI – Dai Stablecoin

Base
– ETH – Ether
– USDC – USD Coin

500+ Wallet Support

Customers should not have to change wallets just to complete a purchase.

Unuspay supports 500+ crypto wallets through wallet integrations, including popular browser and mobile wallets such as:

  • MetaMask
  • Trust Wallet
  • Coinbase Wallet
  • OKX Wallet
  • Safe
  • Ledger-compatible wallet flows
  • WalletConnect-supported wallets

This helps reduce payment friction because customers can pay from the wallet they already know.

Why WooCommerce Merchants Use Unuspay

  • Give crypto-ready customers a payment option — Accept payments from customers who prefer crypto, stablecoins, or wallet-based checkout.
  • Keep checkout clear — Customers select Unuspay in WooCommerce and complete payment through a guided crypto payment flow.
  • Reduce manual payment checking — Webhook-based payment updates help WooCommerce orders move forward after payment.
  • Support modern WooCommerce stores — Works with WooCommerce classic checkout, WooCommerce Checkout Block, and HPOS-compatible order storage.
  • Offer practical stablecoin rails — Support for USDC, USDT, DAI, FDUSD, and TUSD across supported networks.

How It Works

  1. A customer selects Unuspay at WooCommerce checkout.
  2. The customer chooses a supported network, token, and wallet.
  3. The customer completes the crypto payment.
  4. Unuspay sends payment-status updates back to your WooCommerce store by webhook.
  5. WooCommerce updates the order based on the payment result.

Built for Real Store Operations

Crypto payments can create extra questions for store owners:

Did the customer pay? Which order does this payment belong to? Will checkout still feel normal? Will the team need to manually verify every payment?

Unuspay is designed to make the crypto part easier to manage. Customers pay with supported wallets and tokens, while your team keeps working from WooCommerce orders.

Use Unuspay if you want to add crypto payments, but still want your store operations to feel like WooCommerce.

Key Features

  • Cryptocurrency payment gateway for WooCommerce
  • Support for Ethereum, Base, Polygon, BNB Smart Chain, Tron, and EVM-compatible chains
  • Support for native coins and stablecoins on supported networks
  • 500+ crypto wallet support
  • WooCommerce classic checkout support
  • WooCommerce Checkout Block support
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) compatibility declaration
  • Webhook-based order status updates
  • API-key based setup in WooCommerce payment settings

License & Partnership

  • Regulatory Compliance — Unuspay holds a valid U.S. MSB (Money Services Business) license and is applying for a European EMI (Electronic Money Institution) license.
  • Official Partnerships — Unuspay is an official TON blockchain partner, operating TONFinder — the Web3 business directory connecting users to verified merchants. All operations are non-custodial, audited, and fully transparent.

Compatibility

This plugin requires WooCommerce and is intended for stores using standard WooCommerce payment gateway APIs.

Compatibility details for this release:

  • WooCommerce classic checkout: supported
  • WooCommerce Checkout Block: supported
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS): compatibility declared

External services

This plugin connects to Unuspay services to create payment sessions and receive payment-status updates.

It sends:

  • Order reference or external order ID
  • Order totals and currency
  • Order line items
  • Callback or return URLs required for checkout completion

Service endpoints used by the plugin include:

  • https://api.unuspay.com

This plugin depends on the Unuspay external service for payment processing. By using this plugin, you agree to Unuspay’s terms and privacy policy.

Policies:

  • Privacy Policy: https://unuspay.com/privacy-policy/
  • Terms of Use: https://unuspay.com/terms-of-use/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip and activate it.
  2. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > Unuspay.
  4. Enter your API key, webhook secret, wallet set ID, and API base URL.
  5. Enable the gateway and place a test order.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a Unuspay account?

Yes. You need active Unuspay credentials so your WooCommerce store can create payment sessions and receive payment updates.

What blockchains does Unuspay support?

Unuspay supports Ethereum and EVM-compatible chains, Base, Polygon, BNB Smart Chain.

What tokens can customers use?

Customers can pay with supported native coins and stablecoins, including ETH, WETH, POL, BNB, USDC, USDT, DAI, FDUSD, and TUSD, depending on the selected network.

What wallets are supported?

Unuspay supports 500+ wallets through wallet integrations, including MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Coinbase Wallet, OKX Wallet, Safe, Ledger-compatible wallet flows and WalletConnect-supported wallets.

Does this plugin support WooCommerce Checkout Block?

Yes. The plugin includes support for WooCommerce Checkout Block as well as classic WooCommerce checkout.

How are WooCommerce orders updated after payment?

Unuspay sends webhook-based payment-status updates back to your WooCommerce store, helping your team avoid manually matching every crypto payment to an order.
